outcome: Setup connected to the live API for reading: workspace picker, rules, delegation and templates
acceptance_criteria: Opening `/setup/rules` with no `workspace` shows the picker, selects the first active project and rewrites the address to `?workspace=<case_id>`. — verify: open the page with `live-admin` signed in; the address contains `workspace=`, the picker shows the project title, and the rules list shows that workspace's ten rules.

Reloading the page or opening the saved link keeps the workspace; changing the picker re-reads the open tab and updates the address. — verify: select a second workspace; the address and the rows change; reload; the same workspace is selected.
Tab links (Rules, Delegation, Templates) keep `workspace`. — verify: click each tab; the address still holds the same `workspace`.

Rules show `label`, area, version, value or roles and a status text for every row; MISSING rows count in the "not set" badge; UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE and INVALID are not counted as set or not set. — verify: mock fixture and the live read in the browser; badge equals the MISSING row count.
`/setup/rules/finance` and `/setup/rules/delivery` list only rows with area "Finance" / "Delivery". — verify: open each page.

A workspace whose rules read returns 404 shows "You don’t have access to this workspace’s setup. Choose another workspace." with the picker usable, and shows no rule, delegation or template content. — verify: pick a workspace the account has no `policy.read` on (live-none or live-lead; or the mock "Beta Pilot"); the same text shows on all three tabs; network log shows no other Setup read succeeding for it.
A signed-out session shows the signed-out state, not the access text. — verify: clear the session cookie and reload.
Delegation rows show names from `options.people`; an id that is not listed shows "Person not listed". — verify: mock fixture row with delegate id 9.

Templates show name and version, load further pages with Show more using `templates=<cursor>`, and show no line, test-template tag, updated-by or versions. — verify: network log shows a second request with `?templates=` equal to the first response's `cursor`.

Edit rule, Add delegation and Upload version are disabled and show "Changes open once proof upload is connected"; clicking them opens no panel and sends no request. — verify: Playwright asserts no `POST`, `PUT` or `PATCH` request to `/api/v1` after clicking each control on the three tabs.

Unit test: `saveRule`, `addDelegation`, `uploadTemplateVersion` and `uploadEvidence` are not imported by any component in `src/features/setup` after the change. — verify: `npm test` (new vitest) greps the feature sources, or the equivalent import check.
A 500 or network failure on any read shows "We couldn’t load the …" with Retry and does not show the access text; Retry re-reads. — verify: mock failure fixture or blocked request in Playwright.
An empty workspace list shows "No workspaces to show." and makes no `/setup/{case_id}/…` request. — verify: mock with no projects.

The mock (`npm run dev`) shows the same three tabs and the picker with the fixtures above, with no live backend. — verify: run the mock from the lane worktree `frontend/` on its port and open `/setup/rules`.

New and updated tests: unit tests for the status-to-badge count and the id-to-name lookup, and Playwright specs for criteria 1, 2, 6, 9 and 10, updating `e2e/setup.spec.ts`, `setup-delegation.spec.ts`, `setup-templates.spec.ts`. — verify: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e -- setup` from the worktree `frontend/`.

Live check: with Django on 8010 and Next.js on 4970 (LANES.md "Live backend for checks"), signed in as `live-admin`, `/setup/rules`, `/setup/delegation` and `/setup/templates` show the live data for a workspace the account can read, and `live-none` sees the no-access state. — verify: browser, as above.

risk.rationale: Reads only, so no data change. Medium because the workspace scope for organisation-wide Setup is an unconfirmed default (B-21, B-27, B-38), the contract is cross-layer (several endpoints, plus 404-as-no-access handling), and the rules screens expose approval-authority data, so an access leak is possible. Surfaces: ui, api, contract-change, product-decision (the picker and the reads-only default). Risk drops from r1's high because the evidence_id and draft-activate paths are no longer in scope.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
